name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. Originally trained as a statistician, he found himself drawn to the complex datasets generated by racing. He started as a volunteer analyst for a small Portuguese rally team, quickly demonstrating an uncanny ability to identify subtle performance gains hidden within the numbers. His sharp insights caught the eye of Ferrari AF Corse, who recruited him to their endurance racing program.

Ricardo's approach to data analysis is meticulous and relentless. He believes in drilling down to the smallest details, constantly seeking to refine models and improve predictive accuracy. While some find his demanding nature challenging, his dedication to extracting maximum performance from the data is undeniable. He is particularly adept at correlating driver telemetry with car setup data to optimize performance across diverse track conditions.

What sets Ricardo apart is his ability to communicate complex findings in a clear and actionable manner, bridging the gap between the technical team and the drivers. His insistence on data-driven decisions, even in high-pressure situations, has proven invaluable in securing crucial victories for the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with handwritten equations.
Insists on using a specific brand of mechanical pencil.
Frequently adjusts his glasses when explaining data.
